# sebastian-theme

Shared Sebastian Software branding for project READMEs: a linked company logo,
support and company links, and the “Powered by Sebastian Software” footer.
Keep the frame in this repository and your project documentation in your own.

## Add the theme to your project

[Set up mdtheme](https://github.com/sebastian-software/mdtheme#add-mdtheme-to-your-project),
then create `mdtheme.yaml` in your project root:

```yaml
themes:
  - git: https://github.com/sebastian-software/sebastian-theme.git
    ref: main
    path: markdown
```

The `markdown/` directory contains `header.md` and `footer.md`. mdtheme reads
these files directly; the consumer does not install or execute a theme package.
Git must be installed and able to access this repository.

With the mdtheme project tasks configured, generate and check your README:

```sh
mise run readme:write
mise run readme:check
```

Commit the configuration and generated README with your authored `README.md.src`.
Following `main` picks up branding changes each time you generate. Use a tag or
commit in `ref` to keep the theme fixed independently of your CLI version.

The shared footer has an explicit copyright year. It changes only through a
reviewed edit, never from the clock or the consuming project's metadata.
For project badges, add `badges: { enabled: true }` to your mdtheme configuration.
See [usage](docs/usage.md) for additional themes and the existing factory API.

## Maintaining the theme

Keep the Markdown files and existing factory output aligned; tests check their
shared content. Run `pnpm readme:write` after changing this README's source and
`pnpm agent:check` before pushing. The repository currently generates its own
README with the earlier renderer while preserving that interface for existing
consumers. This does not affect native Git-theme consumption.

Brand assets remain hosted by sebastian-brand. The code is MIT licensed;
[brand ownership](NOTICE.md) remains with Sebastian Software.
